svg.title: Precomputed map tile with three editable layers
svg.desc: A residential map reconstructed from the PNG reference. The first layer contains light-gray ground, light-green open land and green vegetation. The second layer contains gray building footprints and dark-gray roads. The third layer contains the Crestwood Dr street label with a white halo and the original map attribution.

g.text: Map tiles by Stamen Design, under CC BY 3.0. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
